_note: TEST FIXTURE ONLY. Canned answers used by scripts/fake-bob.js in automated tests. Never used by the app.

investigator.analysis: calculateTotal() subtracts the raw percentage discount from the subtotal with no validation or clamping. A coupon above 100% yields a negative total, an undefined coupon yields NaN, and invalid prices silently corrupt the result — violating rules 2–9 in docs/cart_rules.md.

tests.name: coupon above 100% never produces a negative total
empty cart with a coupon returns exactly 0
negative discount is clamped to 0% (no surcharge)
NaN or Infinity discount throws RangeError
item with a missing or negative price throws TypeError
totals are rounded to 2 decimal places

repairer.rootCause: src/cart.js lines 8–12: calculateTotal() computes subtotal − subtotal×discount/100 with no input handling. Discounts over 100% push the total below zero, a missing discount turns the math into NaN, and invalid prices or NaN/Infinity discounts are silently accepted.
repairer.fixSummary: Added a default of 0% for missing discounts, RangeError for non-finite discounts, clamping of negative discounts, TypeError for missing/negative prices, a floor at 0 for the total and rounding to 2 decimals. The function signature and export are unchanged.
